# Brief Contract

Produced at the end of convergence and consumed by the same gateway before
retained-plan creation or by the next approved execution owner after planning.

## Required Fields

- Outcome
- Owner
- Success criteria
- Constraints
- Anti-scope
- Direction
- Validation path or explicit gap
- Stop conditions

## Handoff Expectations

- Keep the brief compact, but complete enough to hand to the next approved owner without re-opening the recovered intent.
- Record the next approved owner and any cleared handoff lock when the brief feeds retained-plan creation.
